_meta.source: Wattlyst Pakistan Electricity Bill Index: every bill is computed by the Wattlyst bill engine from data/tariff-pk-2026.json (NEPRA SRO 279(I)/2026 A-1 domestic rates, uniform for ex-WAPDA DISCOs and K-Electric) plus the month's fuel price adjustment and quarterly adjustment below
_meta.method: For each billing month and units level: energy charge (protected: slab-wise; unprotected: all units at the rate of the slab reached) + fixed charge for the sanctioned load below + FC surcharge + QTA for the quarter + FPA for the month (charged to protected and unprotected homes; only the categories in the month's fpa_exempt list are spared, lifeline among those modelled) + GST on the subtotal. Change = this month minus last month. One sanctioned load for every row so months compare like for like.
_meta.status: Add one month at the top at each monthly refresh (FPA notified by NEPRA for the month two months earlier). Keep old months: they are the index history. fpa_verified false = the rate is from a news report (pages mark the month "(FPA reported)"); fpa_ke = the month's FPA source also covers K-Electric (else its row leaves the FPA out); fpa_exempt = the consumer categories that month's FCA order spares (the engine models lifeline, protected and unprotected; EV charging stations and prepaid are not in the index).

ladder.note: Units table on the index page and in the CSV: the current month's bill at every step from 'from' to 'to'. Protected bills only up to defaults.json protected_max_units. Chosen to cover the 'N units bill' searches (growth plan, owner approved 2026-10-15).
